children: Quartzsea caused a $175,000 deposit to its trust account to extend its deadline to consummate an initial business combination to October 19, 2026.
Deposited $175,000 into trust on Sept. 19, 2026 to extend combination deadline from Sept. 19 to Oct. 19, 2026.
Extension authorized by shareholder-approved amendments to its governing agreements dated June 23, 2026.
Permitted month-to-month extensions through Oct. 19, 2026 require deposit each month of the lesser of $175,000 or $0.033 per public share.
